transcript.text: I also need to raise a safety concern before we finalize this plan. I completed my safety review yesterday, but I haven't yet attached it to the launch proposal. My review finds that student mediators may handle only minor peer conflicts — they may not handle threats or moderate conflicts. Additionally, the approved operating protocol must assign two adult supervisors to every mediation session, not one. The current draft's proposal of one adult supervisor and its inclusion of moderate conflicts do not meet these safety requirements.
